decisions.reason: Substantial investment in the resin injection unit and a dedicated website page create public commitment and sunk costs, so escalation theory implies the firm will persist and keep it.
Substantial investment in the resin injection unit and a dedicated website page create public commitment and sunk costs, so escalation theory implies the firm will persist and keep it.
The automatic spray gun is core equipment with its own public page, and the firm's investment and visible commitment make a drop unlikely under escalation of commitment.
Despite being a simpler manual model, it still received its own product page, and sunk costs plus the need to justify the earlier launch make management inclined to keep it.
As a product line with several models, it represents greater investment and public commitment, so escalation of commitment strongly predicts keeping it.

The data logger had little investment relative to core equipment and was only mentioned on the website in 2019, so public commitment is low, and after several years results can no longer be attributed to temporary causes, making a drop more likely.
